plugins.name: cognee-memory
plugins.description: Cognee knowledge graph memory for Claude Code — session-aware storage, auto-routing recall, and persistent learning across sessions. Supports local mode and Cognee Cloud.

skills.name: cognee-code
skills.description: Index a code repository into Cognee's code graph and query it deterministically (callers, impact analysis, paths, endpoints). Use for structural code questions, "index this repo", and checking what a re-index changed.
skills.description_zh: 将仓库索引至Cognee代码图并确定性查询调用者、影响、路径和端点，回答结构问题并检查重索引变化。

skills.name: cognee-forget
skills.description: Forget data stored in Cognee memory. Use when the user asks to forget, delete, or remove something from memory (e.g. "forget what we talked about tennis", "delete that from memory"). Finds the documents in the current dataset whose raw content matches what the user wants forgotten and deletes them.
headings: 2. Find the dataset id of the currently used dataset
3. List the data in the dataset and read candidates' raw content
4. Confirm, then forget each matching document
Broader deletions — explicit user request only
skills.description_zh: 在Cognee当前数据集中查找原始内容与用户遗忘请求匹配的文档并删除，适用于要求忘记、移除或删除记忆。

skills.name: cognee-remember
skills.description: Store data permanently in the Cognee knowledge graph. Accepts a data category (user, project, or agent) to tag the data with the correct node_set for filtered retrieval.
skills.description_zh: 把资料永久存入Cognee知识图谱，按用户、项目或智能体类别设置对应node_set，便于分类检索。

skills.name: cognee-search
skills.description: Search Cognee memory. Session memory is automatically searched on every prompt via hooks. Use this skill explicitly for permanent knowledge graph search, filtered category search, or when you need more results than the automatic lookup provides.
headings: permanent knowledge graph (the default; --graph is the same)
deterministic code graph (indexed repos only — see the cognee-code skill)
Not found in the active dataset? Offer another one
skills.description_zh: 显式检索Cognee永久知识图谱、按类别筛选或获取比自动查询更多的结果；会话记忆另由钩子在每次提示时自动搜索。

skills.name: cognee-switch-datasets
skills.description: Switch this session to another Cognee dataset. Lists the datasets you can write to, lets you pick one, syncs the current session into its dataset, then starts a fresh Cognee session bound to the chosen dataset. All later saves and recalls target the new dataset and the status line shows it.
headings: 1. If the user named a dataset, switch directly
2. Otherwise, list and let the user choose
skills.description_zh: 切换当前会话的Cognee数据集：列出可写数据集、同步原会话，再建立绑定所选数据集的新会话，后续保存与召回均使用新数据集。

skills.name: cognee-sync
skills.description: Sync session cache entries into the permanent Cognee knowledge graph. Run this to make session memory searchable, or it runs automatically at session end.
skills.description_zh: 将会话缓存同步至Cognee永久知识图谱，使会话记忆可检索；也可在会话结束时自动运行。
